car.name: Sneezewort 1965
car.description: A seafoam air-cooled hardtop with a rear flat-six, gentle three-speed gearing and a faithfully fitted salvage-era cockpit.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: 1965 US Chevrolet Corvair Monza 10537 two-door Sport Coupe, standard 164 cu in 95 gross-hp Turbo-Air engine, standard 3-speed manual and 3.27 axle, LHD. No L62 110-hp option, no Corsa, no turbocharger, no Powerglide.

sources.access: Original Chevrolet Vehicle Information Kit scan, visually inspected pages14-17 dimensions/weights;28 steering;31 tires;35 combinations;36 separate gross and net ratings;43 tank;49 transmission. September1964 specifications with February1965 weight/tire revisions. Net values used for runtime; gross retained separately.
Original 1965 Chevrolet sales brochure scan, PDF7 Monza interior and two-door coupe; PDF8 specifications. Reference only; no brochure pixels used as game art.

verifiedFacts.weightDefinition: Empty ready-to-drive standard 10537, fuel included, not shipping or passenger-loaded weight

gearingStatus.individualRatios: Verified standard three-speed 3.22/1.84/1.00, reverse3.22, standard axle3.27. Auto Assist is fictional, not factory Powerglide.

estimates: Period OEM net 78hp/140lb-ft used directly. Gross95hp/154lb-ft is a different rating; neither is relabeled DIN/CEE or modern SAE-certified net. Torque curve between published peaks, 4400 redline/4600 limiter, shifting and launch are estimates. Turbo-Air is a model name, not forced induction.

165/80R13 is a game tire-profile approximation for source 6.50x13 crossply, not an OEM radial fitment claim. Rolling radius is derived from 862 rev/mile at50mph and held constant. Source pressure retained; tire grip/contact behavior estimated.

88mph and17s0-60 are unverified modeling targets. Cd.42, drivetrain efficiency.86, CGheight.5m, collider subgeometry, suspension controls, differential response and brake balance are estimates. No measured performance claim.
Full-fuel curb mass and axle split source values used; no occupants added. Simplified independent suspension and rear-engine behavior do not reproduce every period compliance characteristic.
Original badge-free 2994 artwork and retrofit live numeric instruments are fictional. Shared animated steering wheel and tires retained; no OEM artwork copied into game layers.
